summary: Every party is a ticket: a condensed time stub, a perforated edge, then the facts. Status lives in the stub, so red appears only on a missing deposit.

world.name: Ticket
world.summary: Warm paper, deep teal and indigo, one violet accent. Condensed Bulgarian-Cyrillic display type for times and names, a quiet grotesk for everything else.
world.signature: The ticket stub: time sits in a stub cut off by a perforated dashed edge with two punched notches. The stub carries the status color, so a missing deposit is the only solid red stub on any screen.
rules: Do put the time in a ticket stub and the facts in the body; the stub carries the status color.
Do keep the stub neutral for a healthy party; only a missing deposit gets a solid red stub, a clash or a gap gets an amber tint.
Don't fill empty hours with placeholder rows; empty time is white space on the grid.
Don't show a money figure the data does not hold; write 'не е зададено'.
